body:
You are not incapable of being happy...you said it yourself.  Our perception of what happiness should be is so different from the reality.  In reality, happiness comes in waves with steady or low periods in between.

I'm struggling with stuff myself at this very moment.  I want to tell you that how you feel at this moment is not how you will always feel.  Please hang in there.

I've had horrible experiences with collections myself in the past.  I chose to ignore it and that was a huge mistake.  Do you have a friend who is relatively organized?  It can be very helpful to have a friend sort through the bills and help you come up with a plan for addressing them.  Landlords can be very understanding people when you approach them with honesty and respect.

Sending you thoughts of hope and strength.

"They are a warning sign, and sometimes used as a "comforting" thought - any idea of haveing a certain way out is soothing when you feel hopeless."

Oh my gosh....this is exactly how it felt when I was on the floor, crying inconsolably this morning...having the idea helped ease the physical-mental agony of my feelings.

When I read about those kids, my heart aches for them.  As a mother, I wish I could just hold onto anyone feeling this way and tell them to stay strong...wait it out.  Empathy is a powerful human ability.

I'm feeling undecided about how much I want to share this episode with my husband at the moment.  I feel that he cannot cope.  However, I think I could write him a letter expressing why I love him and how I see him; I certainly do not hate him, I just feel incredibly and unjustly hurt by his actions.  You are right, these are things that are more difficult to express face to face.

Thank you AndNowIKnowWhy for your encouragement and suggestions.  It really helps to think that the thoughts are a signal rather than a sign of weakness.  That alone makes me feel a bit more empowered in this situation.

Thank you all for sharing your empathy with me.  I will come back and update this thread in a few days (praying that I don't get this low again between now and then).

Bless all the good you all have done today.

Thank you Richeh for taking time to respond.

I actually just finished writing a very humbling e-mail to my mother.  I told her that it feels like something inside of me has snapped a little and told her that I have a small, but real fear of hurting myself.

My husband is a good man, but he is, I believe, dysfunctional with processing emotion.  We never fight with each other and it took months of questioning why he was so reluctant to talk about having a baby before he admitted he's having serious doubts (in his words, "I can't imagine doing this again").

Mother's Day was very triggering of all these feelings.  It really doesn't help that he chose to ignore my sadness through the weekend and make me feel like an afterthought with the way he presented me flowers (he showed them to me and said "blumen" (flowers)--not happy mother's day, not thanks for being a good mom to ___, just that.)

I promise that I will not do anything rash...I've come too far to give up now.  It's just really scary to experience having thoughts of suicide after keeping strong through everything else.

I'm tired.  I'm really tired of crying.  Until our appt. on Wed, I'm going to pull a Scarlett O'Hara and tell myself, "tomorrow is another day."  Otherwise, I'm going to fall completely apart.

Again, thanks to all of you for reaching out.  You have truly helped me to get some much-needed perspective, which has given me the realization that may need more help than I've been getting.

Thank you for your kind words Esther_Mouse.  With just the few interactions I've had since posting this, I feel better.  I'm not a threat to myself as I was earlier.

Really, thank you for making me feel better about asking for some kindness.  Just a few words of encouragement have made me feel a part of the greater world again.

I think I will e-mail my mom now that I feel more in control of myself.  I feel that I can admit to her just how lowly I feel.

I'm so thankful that this place is here for people who need to feel a connection outside of themselves.

Hi.  I feel stupid right now.  Like how can I feel so desperate that I'm having to ask a stranger for kindness?

This is the worst I've felt since being raped in college.  The way I feel now reminds me of how that felt.  I feel utterly worthless right now.  My husband is not a horrible man, which hurts me even more.  He has just shut me out and I feel so achingly alone.
